title: Building a game with AI? Show me what you’re building
author: Ok_Mirror_832
selftext:
I’m putting together an AI game studio called Bitboys. I want to invest in talented people, help them build cool games, and grow a studio we can all be proud of.

I can help with development and infrastructure. I have Blackwell 6000 GPUs and a datacenter with lots of compute and storage, and can provide hosting and LLM inference. I could help cover Claude Code or Codex subscriptions as well.

I’m working on a game myself, and have built a pipeline for world creation, assets, and animation.

If you have a demo or prototype you want to take further, drop a link or DM me. Rough is fine. Show me what you’re building and maybe we can work together.

[https://bitboys.com](https://bitboys.com)

comments.author: trai1er_dude
comments.body: Wow looks legit, a crappy one page AI website it must be a legit company not someone trying to steal ideas
